description: jest-image-snapshot 6.5.2 writes new images in a local run (B23e Phase 2c): `v1` stores `shared-image.png`, and `counter` takes its image between two `toMatchSnapshot` calls, so the matchers share the test's counter (`this.snapshotState._counters`): the image is snapshot 2 and the .snap holds `counter 1` and `counter 3`. Every write reaches Jest's totals (`added`), so the Snapshot Summary counts them. `-t "v1|counter"` leaves `v2` out; two files, one worker.
